notes.title: Patch v1.3 released!
notes.content:
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/6452444/be46b5848245db45295bd583e477377440dc3b8e.png[/img]

News in Nortmark patch v1.3:
[list]
[*] Added a new location. It's north-east of Thelon. First visit the inn "At Three Legs" in Scadan to open the location. You can find an arena and shop with demon's card there.
[*] Fixed a bug "Nyz Discovery - Finish librarian quest before talking to countess"
[*] Fixed a few minor bugs.
[/list]

notes.title: Rake in Grass is releasing a new game Rampage Knights!
notes.content:
Hey, Northmark players! We proudly announce a release of our new game [b]Rampage Knights[/b]! The game tells a story of brave heroes who descent into a dark dungeon to face a hideous Warlock and his black magic.

[h1]Game features:[/h1]
[list]
[*]Frenetic action inspired by Golden Axe and Binding of Isaac
[*]Singleplayer campaign or co-op for two players (online and local)
[*]Randomly generated environments with rogue-like elements
[*]Hero visually evolving with new abilities
[*]Dozens of spells and weapons with game changing properties
[*]Long term progress with new classes and features to unlock
[*]Full controller support
[/list]

http://store.steampowered.com/app/314410/

If you like crazy action, absurd magic and hacking and slashing tons of monsters, give it a bash!

[img]http://www.rakeingrass.com/promo/rampage_knights/rk_ansamble.png[/img]
